notes: Stories created for Specialty Match Accuracy with full coverage: schema, logic, facade exposure, tests, integration.

EVAL-P-M2-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-M2-S1.description: Define the data contract for specialty match accuracy including input condition, extracted NUCC taxonomy codes, provider specialty codes, match score, and classification (exact, partial, mismatch). Ensure compatibility with existing specialty_service outputs.

EVAL-P-M2-S2.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Scoring Logic
EVAL-P-M2-S2.description: Implement backend logic to compare user condition-derived NUCC taxonomy codes with provider specialty codes. Compute match accuracy score using exact match, hierarchical similarity, and fallback classification from specialty_service outputs.

EVAL-P-M2-S3.title: Expose Specialty Match Accuracy via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-M2-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include specialty match accuracy results in provider evaluation responses. Ensure alignment with existing provider detail and search flows.

EVAL-P-M2-S4.title: Unit Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy Logic
EVAL-P-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests validating specialty match scoring across scenarios: exact NUCC match, partial taxonomy overlap, unrelated specialties, and missing data handling.

EVAL-P-M2-S5.title: Integration Test for End-to-End Specialty Match Evaluation
EVAL-P-M2-S5.description: Validate end-to-end flow from user condition input through specialty extraction, match scoring, and exposure via evaluate_care_facade. Ensure compatibility with provider search and detail workflows.
